fields.label: keel hoist
fields.description: A ship's winch, cable and cradle. Drop the cable onto a cave mouth or dungeon entrance, or onto a ledge nobody can walk to; then load it like any portal. Cargo rides the cable for a while before it arrives, heavier loads longer. Downed strangers arrive as prisoners and downed wild beasts arrive bound. Raise the cradle to bring up what waits below. The ship cannot launch while the cable is down. RimMandrake: Keel Hoist

fields.label: keel hoist
fields.description: A winch, a cable and a cradle under the keel. Lower cargo, prisoners, the downed and anyone brave enough to ride into a cave mouth or onto a ledge nobody can walk to, then raise what is waiting below. RimMandrake: Keel Hoist

fields.label: hoist restraints
fields.description: Bound in the keel hoist's restraint cradle. The straps hold the legs until they wear loose. RimMandrake: Keel Hoist

fields.label: ruined head-frame
fields.description: A fixed hoist head-frame left standing over a way down: a rusted winch, a cable still threaded through its sheave, a cradle on the end. It is nobody's now. Load it like any portal and the cradle carries cargo, captives and the brave down to where the cable hangs; raise the cradle to bring up what waits below. RimMandrake: Keel Hoist

fields.label: sealed pit
fields.description: A shaft capped with a grate nobody opens, and voices under it. People are kept down there. Nobody goes in, and nobody comes out unless a hoist lifts them, and no hoist will while the keepers still hold this place. RimMandrake: Keel Hoist
